Seven merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `hasPrivilege` under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs`. I took the pinned head to be `master` at `5eb8cba` (the default-branch HEAD). Dates are the commit dates Falkon reports for each change, which is the merge time for these squash-style commits.

1. **#6674** (TRUNK-6823), merged 2026-10-13. Rewrites a Javadoc paragraph in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsAuthorizationManagerFactory.java`, removing and re-adding a line that mentions `Context.hasPrivilege`. @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsAuthorizationManagerFactory.java:48-48}
2. **#6668** (TRUNK-6802), merged 2026-10-13. Adds `OpenmrsPermissionEvaluator.java`, whose Javadoc and code mention `hasPrivilege`. @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsPermissionEvaluator.java:39-39}
3. **#6544** (TRUNK-6799), merged 2026-10-08. Creates the `security` package, which has no earlier history, including `PrivilegeResolution.java` with `return Context.hasPrivilege(privilege);`. @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/PrivilegeResolution.java:30-30} See also @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsAuthenticationToken.java:41-45}
4. **#6598** (TRUNK-6707), merged 2026-10-01. Adds `checkCanView` calling `Context.hasPrivilege(..., false)` in `AdministrationServiceImpl.java`. @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/AdministrationServiceImpl.java:194-229}
5. **#6383** (TRUNK-6712), merged 2026-07-24. Rewrites `UserContext.hasPrivilege` and adds the `hasPrivilege(String, boolean)` overload to `Context.java`, and changes the `AdministrationServiceImpl.java` privilege checks. @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/UserContext.java:494-527} @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/Context.java:762-789}
6. **#6233** (porting TRUNK-6429 and TRUNK-6515), merged 2026-07-01. Removes `isSchedulerManager(User)`, which called `user.hasPrivilege(...)`, and replaces it with `Context.hasPrivilege` calls in `JobRunrSchedulerService.java`. @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/scheduler/jobrunr/JobRunrSchedulerService.java:357-412}
7. **#6186**, merged 2026-06-18. Adds `Context.hasPrivilege(PrivilegeConstants.GET_ALERTS)` in `AlertServiceImpl.java`. @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/notification/impl/AlertServiceImpl.java:117-120}

Gaps in coverage:
- I only diffed files that contain `hasPrivilege` at HEAD, plus the files each in-window commit touched. A commit that removed a `hasPrivilege` line from a file that no longer has one could be missing. The unchecked candidates are `50810cf`, `f46e57d`, `d8fe136` and `22a4bae`.
- `get_diff` returned nothing for some new files, and ref-scoped `grep` returned nothing, so I relied on `list_commits` history for the new security package.
- Search and read limits were close to exhausted, and I did not verify the content of the unchecked commits.
